# superset_annotation_layer (Resource)

Manages an annotation layer in Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_annotation_layer" "example" {
  name        = "Deployments"
  description = "Marks production deployment events."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the annotation layer.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the annotation layer. Maps to the 'descr' API field.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the annotation layer.
